edits.new:
Then the response is status 422 with MSG-GEN-001 naming "signed document"

  Scenario: AC12 Architecture constraints of section 8 hold (new; BR10 to BR15)
    Given the rwb-comms service is deployed with its schema, published events and code
    When the schema, the published events and the code are inspected
    Then no table in rwb_comms holds a signature request state
    Then every signature request read or update goes through the published rwb-document contract
    Then no signature record is written except through the published rwb-treatment contract with method E_SIGNATURE, BRANCH or PAPER
    Then no value of the signature basis, the method list or the status list is held in code
    Then no comms event is published for a signature
    Then no call is made to EasyApp except through the ACE common module e-signature path INT-34
    Then every POST carries an Idempotency-Key and the REST base "/api/recovery/comms/v1" is used
    Then no personal data and no signed PDF content appears in an event, a workflow input or a log

  Scenario: AC13 Error answers of the provided operations (new; 401, 403, 404)
    Given a caller without valid credentials
    When the caller sends a request to a provided signature-request operation of section 12.1
    Then the response is status 401
    Given a caller with valid credentials but without the operation right
    When the caller sends a request to a provided signature-request operation of section 12.1
    Then the response is status 403
    Given a treatment identifier that matches no treatment
    When the caller sends a request to a provided signature-request operation of section 12.1 for that identifier
    Then the response is status 404

  Scenario: AC14 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key (new)
    Given a signature request for "D-0601" was created with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same POST is sent again with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the system creates no second signature request
    Then the response returns the result of the first request
